inlineSql: SELECT A.VCH_DATE,A.CO_BOOK,A.VCH_NO,A.SR_NO,A.LOT_NO,A.IT_CODE As ItCode,A.TAG_NO,A.IT_PCS,A.IT_GWT,A.IT_NWT,0 As TagPcs,0 As TagGwt,0 As TagNwt,A.EMP_CODE,B.BOOK_SNAME,B.MAIN_BOOK FROM LOT_DETL AS A LEFT JOIN BOOK_DATA AS B ON A.CO_CODE = B.CO_CODE AND A.LC_CODE = B.LC_CODE AND A.CO_BOOK = B.CO_BOOK WHERE A.CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.LC_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.IT_SIGN = '+' AND A.LOT_NO = ' ? ' ? UNION ALL SELECT C.VCH_DATE,C.CO_BOOK,C.VCH_NO,C.SR_NO,C.LOT_NO,C.TAG_IT_CODE,C.TAG_NO,0,0,0,C.IT_PCS,C.IT_GWT,C.IT_NWT,C.EMP_CODE,D.BOOK_SNAME,D.MAIN_BOOK FROM LOT_DETL As C LEFT JOIN BOOK_DATA As D On C.CO_CODE = D.CO_CODE And C.CO_BOOK = D.CO_BOOK WHERE C.CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND C.LC_CODE = ' ? ' AND C.IT_SIGN = '-' AND C.LOT_NO = ' ? ' ORDER BY A.VCH_DATE,A.SR_NO

Select ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY A.VCH_DATE,LOT_NO) AS SrNo,A.*,B.IT_NAME,C.AC_SHORT FROM (LOT_DETL AS A LEFT JOIN ITEM_MAST AS B ON A.CO_CODE = B.CO_CODE AND A.IT_CODE = B.IT_CODE)LEFT JOIN AC_MAST AS C ON A.CO_CODE = C.CO_CODE AND A.AC_CODE = C.AC_CODE WHERE A.CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.IT_SIGN = '+' AND A.VCH_DATE >= ' ? MM/dd/yyyy ? ' AND A.VCH_DATE <= ' ? MM/dd/yyyy ? ' AND A.LOT_NO IN(Select A.LOT_NO FROM LOT_DETL AS A WHERE A.CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.LC_CODE = ' ? ' ? C ? AND A.DATA_TYPE = ' ? ' ? AND A.VCH_DATE >= ' ? MM/dd/yyyy ? ' AND A.VCH_DATE <= ' ? MM/dd/yyyy ? ' GROUP BY A.LOT_NO HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN A.IT_SIGN = '+' THEN A.IT_NWT ELSE - A.IT_NWT END) > 0 )

Select A.LOT_NO,A.IT_CODE, SUM(CASE WHEN A.IT_SIGN = '-' THEN A.IT_PCS ELSE 0 END) As AdjPcs,SUM(CASE WHEN A.IT_SIGN = '-' THEN A.IT_GWT ELSE 0 END) As AdjGwt,SUM(CASE WHEN A.IT_SIGN = '-' THEN A.IT_NWT ELSE 0 END) As AdjNwt FROM LOT_DETL AS A WHERE A.CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.LC_CODE = ' ? ' ? C ? AND A.DATA_TYPE = ' ? ' ? AND A.VCH_DATE >= ' ? MM/dd/yyyy ? ' AND A.VCH_DATE <= ' ? MM/dd/yyyy ? ' GROUP BY A.LOT_NO,A.IT_CODE

Select ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY B.CARD_NO,B.MEMB_NAME) AS SrNo,A.MEMB_CODE,B.MEMB_NAME,B.MOBILE_NO,B.CARD_NO,C.AC_ADD1,C.AC_CITY,SUM(CASE WHEN A.ITM_SIGN = '+' THEN A.TOT_POINT ELSE 0 END) as TotPoint,SUM(CASE WHEN A.ITM_SIGN = '-' THEN A.TOT_POINT ELSE 0 END) as AdjPoint,SUM(CASE WHEN A.ITM_SIGN = '+' THEN A.TOT_POINT ELSE - A.TOT_POINT END) as BalPoint,Null AS DEL_DATE FROM (POINT_DATA AS A INNER JOIN POINT_MEMB AS B ON A.CO_CODE = B.CO_CODE AND A.POINT_CODE = B.POINT_CODE And A.MEMB_CODE = B.MEMB_CODE )LEFT JOIN AC_MAST AS C ON A.CO_CODE = C.CO_CODE And A.MEMB_CODE = C.AC_CODE WHERE A.CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.LC_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.POINT_CODE = '01' and VCH_DATE <= ' ? MM/dd/yyyy ? ' GROUP BY A.MEMB_CODE,B.MEMB_NAME,B.MOBILE_NO,B.CARD_NO,C.AC_ADD1,C.AC_CITY ORDER BY B.CARD_NO,B.MEMB_NAME
Select * From USER_SET WHERE LC_CODE = ' ? ' AND USER_NAME = ' ? ' AND SUB_MENU = ' ? '
SELECT KR_CODE FROM LOT_DETL WHERE CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND KR_CODE <> '' GROUP BY KR_CODE ORDER BY KR_CODE
SELECT AC_CITY FROM AC_MAST WHERE CO_CODE = ' ? ' GROUP BY AC_CITY ORDER BY AC_CITY
SELECT AC_AREA FROM AC_MAST WHERE CO_CODE = ' ? ' GROUP BY AC_AREA ORDER BY AC_AREA

Select ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY C.AC_NAME,A.DEL_DATE) AS SrNo,A.AC_CODE,C.AC_NAME,C.AC_ADD1,C.AC_MOBILE,A.DEL_DATE,D.DATA_TYPE,SUM(CASE WHEN B.ORD_SIGN = '+' THEN B.ORD_AMT ELSE 0 END) as OrderAmt,SUM(CASE WHEN B.ORD_SIGN = '-' THEN B.ORD_AMT ELSE 0 END) AS AdjAmt,SUM(CASE WHEN B.ORD_SIGN = '+' THEN B.ORD_AMT ELSE -B.ORD_AMT END) as BalAmt,A.TOT_AMT As OrdItmTotal FROM ((SL_ORD_DATA AS A LEFT JOIN SL_ORD_ADJ AS B ON A.CO_CODE = B.CO_CODE And A.LC_CODE = B.ORD_LC And A.CO_YEAR = B.ORD_YRCD And A.CO_BOOK = B.ORD_DBCD And A.VCH_NO = B.ORD_NO) LEFT JOIN AC_MAST AS C ON A.CO_CODE = C.CO_CODE AND A.AC_CODE = C.AC_CODE)LEFT JOIN BOOK_DATA AS D ON A.CO_CODE = D.CO_CODE AND A.LC_CODE = D.LC_CODE AND A.CO_BOOK = D.CO_BOOK WHERE A.CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.LC_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.VCH_DATE < ' ? MM/dd/yyyy ? ' ? C ? AND D.DATA_TYPE = ' ? ' ? AND B.AC_CITY = ' ? ' ? AND B.AC_AREA = ' ? ' ? GROUP BY A.AC_CODE,C.AC_NAME,C.AC_ADD1,C.AC_MOBILE,A.DEL_DATE,D.DATA_TYPE,A.TOT_AMT ORDER BY C.AC_NAME,A.DEL_DATE

Select ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY A.VCH_DATE,A.VCH_NO) AS SrNo,D.BOOK_SNAME,A.VCH_NO,A.VCH_DATE,A.AC_NAME,A.CO_BOOK,A.AC_CODE,D.MAIN_BOOK, SUM(CASE WHEN B.ORD_SIGN = '+' THEN B.ORD_AMT ELSE 0 END) as OrderAmt,SUM(CASE WHEN B.ORD_SIGN = '-' THEN B.ORD_AMT ELSE 0 END) AS AdjAmt,SUM(CASE WHEN B.ORD_SIGN = '+' THEN B.ORD_AMT ELSE -B.ORD_AMT END) as BalAmt FROM (SL_ORD_DATA AS A LEFT JOIN SL_ORD_ADJ AS B ON A.CO_CODE = B.CO_CODE And A.LC_CODE = B.ORD_LC And A.CO_YEAR = B.ORD_YRCD And A.CO_BOOK = B.ORD_DBCD And A.VCH_NO = B.ORD_NO) LEFT JOIN BOOK_DATA AS D ON A.CO_CODE = D.CO_CODE AND A.LC_CODE = D.LC_CODE AND A.CO_BOOK = D.CO_BOOK WHERE A.CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.LC_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.AC_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.VCH_DATE <= ' ? MM/dd/yyyy ? ' GROUP BY D.BOOK_SNAME,A.VCH_NO,A.VCH_DATE,A.AC_NAME,A.CO_BOOK,A.AC_CODE,D.MAIN_BOOK ORDER BY A.VCH_DATE,A.VCH_NO

SELECT Sum(CR_AMT - DR_AMT) as BalAmt FROM AC_DATA WHERE CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND CO_YEAR = ' ? ' AND AC_CODE = ' ? ' and VCH_DATE < ' ? MM/dd/yyyy ? ' ? C ? AND DATA_TYPE = ' ? ' ? HAVING SUM(CR_AMT-DR_AMT) <> 0

Select ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY A.VCH_DATE,A.VCH_NO) AS SrNo,D.BOOK_SNAME,A.VCH_NO,A.VCH_DATE,B.MEMB_NAME,A.CO_BOOK,A.MEMB_CODE,D.MAIN_BOOK,A.POINT_TYPE, ? As POINT_VAL,SUM(CASE WHEN A.ITM_SIGN = '+' THEN A.TOT_POINT Else -A.TOT_POINT End * ? ) As PointVal, SUM(Case When A.ITM_SIGN = '+' THEN A.TOT_POINT ELSE 0 END) as OrderAmt,SUM(CASE WHEN A.ITM_SIGN = '-' THEN A.TOT_POINT ELSE 0 END) AS AdjAmt,SUM(CASE WHEN A.ITM_SIGN = '+' THEN A.TOT_POINT ELSE -A.TOT_POINT END) as BalAmt FROM (POINT_DATA AS A LEFT JOIN POINT_MEMB AS B ON A.CO_CODE = B.CO_CODE And A.MEMB_CODE = B.MEMB_CODE AND A.POINT_CODE = B.POINT_CODE) LEFT JOIN BOOK_DATA AS D ON A.CO_CODE = D.CO_CODE AND A.LC_CODE = D.LC_CODE AND A.CO_BOOK = D.CO_BOOK WHERE A.CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.LC_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.MEMB_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.VCH_DATE <= ' ? MM/dd/yyyy ? ' GROUP BY D.BOOK_SNAME,A.VCH_NO,A.VCH_DATE,B.MEMB_NAME,A.CO_BOOK,A.MEMB_CODE,D.MAIN_BOOK ,A.POINT_TYPE ORDER BY A.VCH_DATE,A.VCH_NO
Select * From AC_MAST WHERE CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND AC_CODE = ' ? '
SELECT AC_NAME As AcNameL,AC_CODE As AcCodeL, AC_GR AS GroupL,AC_ADD1 As AddressL,AC_PHONE As PhoneL,AC_MOBILE As MobileL FROM AC_MAST WHERE CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND LC_CODE = ' ? ' ORDER BY AC_NAME
SELECT BOOK_NAME ,CO_BOOK ,BOOK_TYPE,ITM_TYPE,MAIN_BOOK,BOOK_SNAME,BOOK_INOUT,MENU_NAME FROM BOOK_DATA WHERE CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND LC_CODE = ' ? ' AND CO_BOOK = ' ? '

Select ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY DELETE_DATE,A.BOOK_NAME,SR_NO) AS SrNo,A.BOOK_NAME,A.VCH_DATE,A.VCH_NO,A.SR_NO,A.DELETE_DATE,AC_CODE,AC_NAME, A.VCH_VAL_DR,A.VCH_VAL_CR,FINE_TYPE,VCH_FINE_DR,VCH_FINE_CR,A.MAIN_USER,DELETE_USER,VCH_DESC FROM DELETE_DATA AS A LEFT JOIN BOOK_DATA AS D ON A.CO_CODE = D.CO_CODE AND A.LC_CODE = D.LC_CODE AND A.CO_BOOK = D.CO_BOOK WHERE A.CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.LC_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.DELETE_DATE >= ' ? MM/dd/yyyy ? ' AND A.DELETE_DATE <= ' ? MM/dd/yyyy ? ' ? C ? AND D.DATA_TYPE = ' ? ' ? AND B.AC_CITY = ' ? ' ? AND B.AC_AREA = ' ? ' ? ORDER BY DELETE_DATE,A.BOOK_NAME,SR_NO
